title: CraftingControl
description: This plugin makes so you can only craft specific crafting recepies.
body:
## CraftingControl

Makes only specific items craftable (configurable in the **config.yml**)

# config.yml
```
# CraftingControl Configuration
# =============================
# Only items listed below can be crafted. All other recipes are disabled.
#
# Format: Use UPPER_CASE material names with underscores replacing spaces
# Example: WIND_CHARGE, DIAMOND_SWORD, IRON_PICKAXE, COOKED_BEEF
#
# Find all material names at:
# https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Material.html
#
# Enter an item that can be crafted:
allowed-items:
  - WIND_CHARGE
```

_What can be this used for?_

It can be used for PvP servers, so you can craft breeze rods into wind charges but you cant craft a crafting table for example.

_Why this plugin?_

All other plugins here on modrinth for 1.21.x disable all of the crafting recipies with no way to configure what you want to be craftable.
